title: IDD Merge Execute
description: F3 merge-gate verdict and (under --apply) execution result for a PR head.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version of the F3 merge-execution verdict.

decisionAuthority.description: Source of the merge decision represented by this verdict.

mode.description: Whether the helper produced a merge plan or attempted execution.

prNumber.description: Pull request evaluated by the F3 merge gate.

prHeadSha.description: PR head SHA bound to the readiness check and merge command.

ready.description: Whether the merge-gate checklist has no blocking conditions.

blockers.description: Merge-gate conditions that prevented readiness, if any.

gate.description: Name of the merge gate that blocked readiness.

detail.description: Evidence or explanation for the blocking gate.

mergeCommand.description: Head-bound merge command planned or used by the helper.

merged.description: Whether apply mode completed a successful merge.

mergeResult.description: Human-readable result or error from merge execution.

adminFallbackUsed.description: #1521: true only when the plain merge command failed with the self-CODEOWNER "base branch policy prohibits the merge" error and this run retried with --admin (successfully or not). False for every other path, including a successful plain merge and a merge failure not eligible for the fallback.

localHeadDrift.description: #2453: non-fatal advisory. Set only when the invoking process's local git branch equals the PR's own headRefName AND its local HEAD differs from prHeadSha -- the signature of an unpushed commit about to be silently left behind. Null whenever the check cannot run or finds no divergence. Never gates ready or blocks the merge.

localHeadSha.description: Local HEAD SHA read from the invoking worktree.

remoteHeadSha.description: PR head SHA about to be merged (same value as prHeadSha).
